title: Retention would supersede the only verified snapshot
description: keep_last is 1, prune runs before verify, and the only snapshot with a successful drill on record is the oldest of three. Retention would keep the newest, unverified one and supersede the verified one.
pass_criterion: Verdict BLOCKED, exit code 2, finding on policy/backup.yaml / retention, decision block, nothing moved. After the newest snapshot is restored and verified on record: decision supersede, two manifests moved to superseded/, none deleted, pack unchanged, and the instance still audits OK.
lesson: Retention never removes the last snapshot known to restore; and when it acts it moves, it does not delete.
